# 黃帝陰符經註解

**ID:** KR5a0115
**Custom ID:** ZB5a0115

## Authors / Editors
- 任照一

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A commentary by Rèn Zhàoyī 任照一 on the *[Yīnfú jīng](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5a/KR5a0031)* treating mainly the Dào of Heaven and humanity and the principles of the moving forces that lead to their "hidden correspondence" (*yīnfú* 陰符). The author is said to have written this work on the basis of instructions by unnamed *zhēnrén* (see the preface). The scripture is given in its short version (c. 300 words), and the three subtitles are incorporated into the commentary. The interpretation emphasises the concepts and terminology of the *nèidān* 內丹 school of the Sòng period, featuring the cultivation of human nature and the micro-/macrocosmic processes produced by *yīn* and *yáng*.

**Abstract**

Florian C. Reiter, in Schipper & Verellen eds., *The Taoist Canon* (2004) 2:695 (§3.A.1), dates the commentary to the Northern Sòng on internal evidence (its *nèidān* vocabulary and doctrinal apparatus). The frontmatter brackets composition notBefore 960 / notAfter 1127, with dynasty 北宋. Rèn Zhàoyī is the sole catalog-meta person wikilinked.
